channel.title: CVCC Course Schedule – Changelog
channel.description: Version history and release notes for the CVCC Course Schedule application.

item.title: v2.4.1 – Search performance fix for large merged terms
item.description: Search box now uses a 250ms debounce — the table re-renders once after you stop typing instead of on every keystroke, resolving stale results when searching across 1,000+ courses in All Campuses merged terms. The filter badge count still updates immediately while typing.

item.title: v2.4.0 – All Campuses merged term (◆)
item.description: When multiple Curriculum JSON files share the same semester (e.g. Main Campus + ATEC for Fall 2026), a synthetic ◆ Fall 2026 — All Campuses (Curriculum) option is automatically created and selected by default. Both campus files are fetched in parallel and merged into a single unified course list so all filters and search work across campuses simultaneously. Merged options use a ◆ diamond prefix to distinguish them from single-campus terms.

item.title: v2.3.0 – Filter bar & header compaction
item.description: Filter bar collapses to a single row with an animated expand/collapse toggle and an active-filter count badge. Delivery and Status dropdowns right-sized; Search, Days, and Time of Day merged onto one row. Header tightened with smaller logo and consolidated meta row. Fixed location display for courses whose building code is "TBD" — now shows the correct campus name from the secLocation field.

item.title: v2.2.0 – CE features, Time of Day filter, Important Dates
item.description: New Time of Day filter: Morning (before noon), Afternoon (noon–5 PM), Evening (after 5 PM). CE table layout restored with Contact Hours, Tuition & Other Fees columns, and a Register button. Important Dates modal shows add/drop, refund, and withdrawal deadlines per section. Section notes use an animated expand/collapse.

item.title: v2.1.0 – UI polish & font update
item.description: Switched to Inter font. Delivery tag renamed from "Traditional" to "Blended". Last Updated timestamp moved under logo. Fixed search placeholder color in dark mode. Term names rewritten for clarity (Flex → Late Start).

item.title: v2.0.0 – Vue 3 SPA rewrite
item.description: Complete rewrite as a Vue 3 single-page application. Features: dark mode, Print/PDF panel, Open/Closed pill counters, full-viewport pinned layout, reactive filters (Delivery, Location, Status, Days, Search), auto-select of nearest upcoming term, and dynamic JSON file loading from get_schedules.php.

item.title: v1.0.0 – Initial launch
item.description: Initial public release. HTML table view of course sections with CVCC branding, alternating row colors, clickable links, delivery method detection, instructor column, remaining seats display, and section notes.
